description: The refusal of the move with `into` when a consumer cannot follow the object: the local variable Used is read by an Assign of its action; in another action it is out of reach of that Assign. The native move would leave the reference pointing to nothing; the verb checks each consumer after the move, refuses, and the whole job does not enter. The clean path is in tests/jobs/refactor-reparent.json.
expectError: move into: 1 consumer(s) of ILocalVariable 'Used' cannot follow it into IServerAction:RpOther
would be left pointing at nothing
